answer: A farm of 44 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in quill, queued in ivory, and basalt publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 59 identities per epoch. A farm of 1983 identities would post 2196 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
